desc: Ideation complete: model the process as a complete ternary majority tree and choose a bottom-up DP.
Implement robust input parsing for N and the binary string, filtering only '0'/'1' characters and handling either contiguous or space-separated bits.
Implement the compact one-state DP: leaves have original value from A and change cost 1; for each internal node, compute its original majority value and the minimum flips needed to change it.

For each triple, compute each child's cost to output the parent's opposite value: 0 if the child already has that value, otherwise the child's change cost; the parent's change cost is the sum of the two smallest such costs.
Use iterative level-by-level array compression with no recursion or string slicing, keeping memory and runtime suitable for N = 13.
Print the root's change cost, which is the minimum number of flips needed to change the final value.
Test on the provided samples and edge cases such as N=1, all zeros, all ones, and maximum N performance.
If the compact DP fails any sample or edge case, fall back to the explicit two-state DP storing cost-to-make-0 and cost-to-make-1 for each node.
